purpose: Bounded read-only own-tooling CPU and memory diagnosis after refused015; not a benchmark trial or retrospective attribution.
command:
$cpuClock=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$cpuFirst=@{}
$cpuLogical=[Environment]::ProcessorCount
foreach($cpuProc in Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){try{$cpuValue=$cpuProc.CPU;if($null -eq $cpuValue){continue};$cpuStart=$cpuProc.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks.ToString();$cpuFirst["$($cpuProc.Id):$cpuStart"]=@([double]$cpuValue,$cpuClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds)}catch{}finally{$cpuProc.Dispose()}}
Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
$cpuRows=@(foreach($cpuProc in Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){try{$cpuValue=$cpuProc.CPU;if($null -eq $cpuValue){continue};$cpuStart=$cpuProc.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks.ToString();$cpuKey="$($cpuProc.Id):$cpuStart";$cpuAt=$cpuClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;if($cpuFirst.ContainsKey($cpuKey)){$cpuElapsed=$cpuAt-$cpuFirst[$cpuKey][1];$cpuDelta=[double]$cpuValue-$cpuFirst[$cpuKey][0];if($cpuElapsed -gt 0 -and $cpuDelta -ge 0){[pscustomobject]@{name=$cpuProc.ProcessName;pid=$cpuProc.Id;startUtcTicks=$cpuStart;cpuSeconds=$cpuDelta;elapsedSeconds=$cpuElapsed;cpuMachinePct=100*$cpuDelta/($cpuElapsed*$cpuLogical);workingSetMiB=$cpuProc.WorkingSet64/1MB;privateMiB=$cpuProc.PrivateMemorySize64/1MB}}}}catch{}finally{$cpuProc.Dispose()}})
[pscustomobject]@{logical=$cpuLogical;scope='Matched accessible processes only; exited/new/inaccessible processes omitted; current diagnostic, not retrospective015 attribution.';topCpu=@($cpuRows|Sort-Object cpuMachinePct -Descending|Select-Object -First 20);topMemory=@($cpuRows|Sort-Object privateMiB -Descending|Select-Object -First 10)}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
